senses.gloss:
r. 4th cl. (इर) कृशिर (कृश्यति)
To make thin or small.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Small, thin, little, minute.
2 Thin, spare, emaciated.
3 Weak, feeble.
E.
कृश to pare or make thin, क्त affix, deriv. irr.

r. 1st cl. (आ) औकृश (कर्षति) and 6th cl. (कृषति-ते)
1 To draw or make furrows.
2 To plough.
With अप,
1 To draw down.
2 To debase.
3 To disregard.
With अव,
1 To draw out or off.
2 To disregard or contemn.
With आङ्,
To attract, to draw to.
With उत्,
1 To raise, to draw up.
2 To raise, to excite, to make high, proud, loud, &c.
With सम,
To draw together.
With सम and नि,
To bring near or close to.

f. (-ता)
Leanness, thinness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कृशत्वं.

mf. (-रः-रा)
1 A dish composed of milk, sesamum, and rice.
2 Rice and pease boiled together with a few spices, commonly Khichree; also कृसर.

m. (-रः)
1 A dish consisting of sesamum and grain.
2 A mixture of rice and peas with a few spices.
E.
कॄ to scatter, सरः Uṇādi affix; also कृशर.

f. (-ला)
The hair of the head.
E.
कृश minute, ल what receives.

m. (-कुः)
1 Heating.
2 Grieving.
E.
कृश to make small, and काकु aff.

m. (-क्षः)
A spider.
E.
कृश, अक्षि eye, टच् aff.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Spare, thin, emaciate.
f. (-ङ्गी)
1 A woman with a slender shape.
2 A plant, commonly Priyangu: see प्रियङ्गु.
E.
कृश thin, अङ्ग the body, अण् and ङीष् affs.

m. (-नुः)
1 A name of fire.
2 A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.)
E.
कृश to make thin, आनुक Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ताः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
कृशानु fire, and रेतस् semen virile.

m. (-श्वः)
The name of a sage.

m. (-श्वी)
A dancer, an actor, a tumbler.
E.
कृशाश्व the name of a saint, the author of directions to players, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 What or who makes furrows or ploughs.
2 Attractive, attrahent.
m. (-कः)
1 The ploughshare.
2 A husbandman, a peasant.
E.
कृष to plough, &c. Uṇādi affix, क्वुन्; also कृषिक.

m. (-णः)
A husbandman.

m. (-णुः)
A name of fire: see कृशानु.

f. (-षिः)
1 Husbandry, agriculture.
2 Ploughing, cultivating the soil, &c.
E.
कृष to plough, इक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
1 The ploughshare.
2 A husbandman, a cultivator.
E.
कृष to plough, Uṇādi affix किकन्; also कृषक.

m. (-वी)
A cultivator, a farmer.
E.
कृषि, and नीविन् who lives by.

n. (-लं)
Agricultural produce or profit.
E.
कृषि, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
One who lives by agriculture, &c.
m. (-लः)
A husbandman.
E.
कृषि agriculture, वलच् affix, and इ made ई.

m. (-रः)
An appellation of ŚIVA.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Ploughed or tilled, a field, &c.
E.
कृष to plough, affix क्त.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
Sown in ripening after ploughing, (rice, &c.)
E.
कृष्ट ploughed, पच to ripen, and क्यप् affix; in some places the grain is sown without previous ploughing, whence it is called अकृष्टपच्य.

mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं)
Sown or rather ripening after ploughing: see कृष्टपच्य.

m. (-ष्टिः)
A teacher, a learned man or Paṇḍita.
f. (-ष्टिः)
Ploughing, cultivating the soil.
2 Attracting, drawing.
E.
कृष to plough, to trace, ति or क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Devoted to Kṛṣṇa.
E.
कृष्णं second case, श्रित serving; also कृष्णश्रित.

mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं)
Black or dark blue.
m. (-ष्णः)
1 Black, the colour, or dark blue, which is often confounded with it by the Hindus.
2 KṚṢṆA, the most celebrated form of VIṢṆU, or rather VIṢṆU himself; he is distinct from the ten Avatāras or incarnations, being identified with the deity.
3 VYĀSA, a sage, the compiler of the Vedas.
4 A name of ARJUNA.
5 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
6 A crow.
7 A fruit, Karonda or Karinda, (Carissa carondas.)
8 The dark half of the lunar month from full to new moon.
n. (-ष्णं)
1 Black pepper.
2 Iron.
3 Blue vitriol.
4 Black agallochum.
f. (-ष्णा)
1 A name of DRAUPADĪ wife of the PĀṆḌAVAS.
2 The indigo plant.
3 Long pepper.
4 A grape.
5 A drug, commonly Kakoli.
6 Kalonji, (Nigella Indica): see कृष्णजीरक.
7 Black mustard, (the name is applied to other vegetable substances of a dark colour.)
8 The Kṛṣṇā river in the Dekhin.
9 A black leech, considered poisonous.
E.
कृष to attract, as the minds of men, &c. नक् Uṇādi affix; (this is applied to KṚṢṆA, &c.) else, कृष to tinge, affix the same; again कृष्ण black, &c. and अच् affix, fem. affix टाप्.

n. (-न्दं)
The red lotus, (Nymphaea rubra.)
E.
कृष्ण black, and कन्द stalk.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Criminal, guilty.
n. (-र्म्म)
1 Making black.
2 Cauterising.
E.
कृष्ण black, and कर्म्मन् action.

m. (-कः)
A raven.
E.
कृष्ण black, and काक a crow.

n. (-ष्ठं)
A black variety of agallochum.
E.
कृष्ण, and काष्ठ wood.

m. (-लिः)
A plant, (Mirabilis jalapa.)

m. (-लः)
A gamester, a gambler.

f. (-शी)
The fourteenth day in the dark half of a month.
E.
कृष्ण dark, चतुर्द्दशी fourteen; it is the day preceding new moon.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Formerly or in a former existence, KṚṢṆA.
E.
कृष्ण, and चरट् affix, implying former state of being; also कृष्णरुप्य.

f. (-डा)
A shrub, (Poinciana pulcherrima.)

n. (-र्णं)
Rust of iron, iron filings.
E.
कृष्ण black, and चूर्णं powder, dust.

f. (-टा)
Indian spikenard: see जटामांसी.
E.
कृष्ण black, जटा twisted hair, to which its entangled stalks are compared.

m. (-कः)
Kalonji, a plant having a small black seed, which is used for medical and culinary purposes, (Nigella Indica, Rox.)
E.
कृष्ण black, and जीरक cummin seed.

f. (-ता)
Blackness.
E.
तल् added to कृष्ण; with त्व, कृष्णत्वं.

n. (-म्रं)
A kind of Sandal wood.
E.
कृष्ण, and तास्र copper, of a dusky copper hue.

m. (-रः)
A deer, an antelope.
E.
कृष्ण black, and तार the pupil of the eye, black-eyed.

f. (-ता)
A plant, black Teöri: see चिवृता.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Having bad or discoloured teeth.
E.
कृष्ण, and दशन a tooth.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Black-bodied.
m. (-हः)
A large black bee.
E.
कृष्ण black, and देह the body.

m. (-नः)
A name of VYĀSA, the compiler of the Vedas, and Purāṇas.
E.
a compound of two other names of the sage: see कृष्ण, and द्वैपायन.

m. (-रः)
A dark species of Datura or thorn apple, (Datura fastuosa): see घत्तूर.

m. (-क्षः)
The dark half of a month, the fifteen days during which the moon is in the wane.
E.
कृष्ण dark, and पक्ष fortnight or half month.

m. (-कः)
A tree bearing a small fruit, which, when ripe, is of a black colour, commonly Karinda or Karonda, (Carissa carondas.)
E.
कृष्ण black, and पाक what is ripe, from पच to ripen, to cook, and घञ् affix; also कृष्णफल, and कृष्णपाकफल.

m. (-लः)
The Karonda: see the preceding.
E.
फल fruit, added to कृष्णपाक.

f. (-ला)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
कृष्ण black, and पिङ्गल tawny; being of such of such a colour.

m. (-कः)
A dark kind of Māyana, (Vangueria spinosa).
E.
कृष्ण black, and पिण्डीतक the Mayan or Mayana tree.

m. (-रः)
A dark kind of Mayan: see the preceding.

f. (-ली)
The black ant.
E.
कृष्ण, and पिपील ant.

m. (-ष्पः)
A black kind of Datūra.
f. (-ष्पी)
Another plant: see प्रियङ्गु.
E.
कृष्ण black, and पुष्प a flower.

(-लः)
A fruit tree, the Karinda: see कृष्णपाक.
f. (-ला)
A shrub, (Serratula anthelmintica): see सोमराजी.
E.
कृष्ण black, and फल fruit.

m. (-कः)
A fruit: see the preceding; also कृष्णपाकफल.

f. (-मिः)
A country with a dark soil, one of mould, blue clay, &c.
E.
कृष्ण black, and भूमि earth; also with a final अ, कृष्णभूमः.

f. (-जा)
A species of grass, described as a nourishing food for cattle.
E.
कृष्णभूमि black earth, and ज born, produced.

f. (-दी)
A medicinal plant: see कटुकी.
E.
कृष्ण black, hence, dirt or excrement, and भेदी what breaks, or dissipates.

m. (-द्गः)
A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus max.)
E.
कृष्ण black, मुद्ग phaseolus.

f. (-मृत्)
A country with a soil of a dark colour.
E.
कृष्ण black, and मृत् earth: see कृष्णभूमि.

f. (-का)
See the preceding.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
Formerly KṚṢṆA: see कृष्णचर.
E.
कृष्ण, and रुप्य affix, implying past state of being.

n. (-णं)
A factitious salt, either that prepared by evaporation from saline soil, or the medicinal kind, called Bit Loben or Bit Noben, a muriate of soda with a proportion of sulphur and iron.
E.
कृष्ण black, and लवण salt.

m. (-लः)
A Ratti, a weight, the berry so used; or an artificial weight derived from it, the berry averaging about 1¼ grain, the weight 2(3/16) grains.
f. (-ला)
A shrub bearing a small black and red berry, the Ratti or Gunja: see गुञ्जा.
E.
कृष्ण blackness, and ल what gets, from ला to obtain, affix ड and fem. affix टाप्.

m. (-कः)
A Ratti, the jeweller's weight, the fifth of a Māṣa.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-हं)
The loadstone.
E.
कृष्ण what attracts, and लोह iron.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Of a purple colour.
E.
कृष्ण black, and लोहित red; of which two colours purple is supposed to consist.

m. (-क्त्रः)
The black faced monkey.
E.
कृष्ण black, and वक्त्र the face.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Black or dark blue.
n. (-र्णं)
The colour black.
E.
कृष्ण and वर्ण colour.

m. (-र्त्ना)
1 Fire.
2 RĀHU or the personified ascending node.
3 A low man, an outcaste, a profligate, a blackguard.
4 The marking nut plant.
E.
कृष्ण black, and वर्त्मन् a path or way; whose way is darkness.

f. (-ल्ली)
A plant, a dark kind of Babul, (Ocymum pilosum).

m. (-रः)
A black monkey.
E.
कृष्ण black, and वानर an ape.

m. (-जः)
A red variety of the Morunga: see रक्तशीग्र.
E.
कृष्ण black, and वीज the seed.

f. (-न्ता)
1 The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
2 A leguminous plant, (Glycine debilis.)
E.
कृष्ण black, and वृन्त foot-stalk.

f. (-का)
A tree, (Gmelina arborea): see गम्भारी.

m. (-रः)
The black antelope: see कृष्णसार.

mf. (-रः-रा)
A timber tree, Sisū, (Dalbergia Sisu, Rox.)
m. (-रः)
1 The black antelope.
2 Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.)
2 A thorny plant, (Euphorbia tirucalli, &c.)
E.
कृष्ण black, and सार essence.

m. (-लिः)
A sort of rice of a dark colour.
E.
कृष्ण, and शालि rice.

f. (-म्बी)
A sort of bean, (Dolichos virosus.)
E.
कृष्ण, and शिम्बी a Dolichos.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A buffalo.
E.
कृष्ण black, and शृङ्ग a horn, black, horned.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Worshipping or devoted to KṚṢṆA.
E.
कृष्ण, and श्रित attached.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Devoted to or the votary of KṚṢṆA.
E.
कृष्ण, and आश्रित attached or devoted to.

m. (-खः)
A friend or follower of KṚṢṆA, especially ARJUNA.
E.
कृष्ण, and सखि a friend, टच् affix in this class of compounds.

f. (-खी)
Cummin-seed.

m. (-र्पः)
A black snake.
E.
कृष्ण, and सर्प a snake.

m. (-पः)
Black mustard.
E.
कृष्ण, and सर्षप mustard.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The black antelope.
E.
कृष्ण black, and सारङ्ग a deer.

m. (-थिः)
ARJUNA.
E.
कृष्ण, and सारथि charioteer; driven by KṚṢṆA.

m. (-न्धः)
A tree which bears black blossoms, the Tamāla tree.
E.
कृष्ण black, and स्कन्ध the shoulder: see कालस्कन्ध.

n. (-रु)
Agallochum or aloe wood, the black variety.
E.
कृष्ण, and अगुरु aloe wood.

m. (-लः)
The mountain Raivata, part of the western portion of the Vindhya chain; it is also one of the nine principal mountains that separate the same divisions or Varṣas of the known world.
E.
कृष्ण black, and अचल a mountain.

f. (-दी)
The name of a river, possibly the Kistṇa in the Dekin.
E.
कृष्ण, and नदी a river, the river of KṚṢṆA; also other analogous names, as कृष्णसमुद्भवा, कृष्णवेण्या, कृष्णगङ्गा, &c.; also कृष्णा.

n. (-षं)
Iron.
E.
कृष्ण black, and आमिप flesh, substance.

n. (-सं)
Iron, crude or black iron.
E.
कृष्ण black, and अयस iron.

m. (-र्च्चिः)
A name of fire.
E.
कृष्ण black, and अर्च्चिस् flame.

m. (-कः)
A black species of basil: see कृष्णवल्ली.
E.
कृष्ण black, and अर्जक basil.

m. (-सः)
The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
E.
कृष्ण the deity, and आवास abode.

f. (-का)
Black mustard.
E.
कृष्ण black, कन् affix, the fem. form.

m. (-मा)
Blackness.
E.
कृष्ण, and इमनिच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Blackening, making black.
E.
कृष्णं, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Blackened, made black.
E.
कृष्ण, कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Being or become black, &c.
E.
कृष्ण, भूत become, च्चि augment.

m. (-क्षुः)
A sort of sugar cane.
E.
कृष्ण black, and इक्षु sugar cane.
